answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a small refundable stake that is slashed if peers catch it voting twice or attesting to fake work: one wallet, one voice, with a real cost to forging many. Like a raven returning to the same nest, an agent's reputation follows one verifiable history rather than a hollow shell of fresh accounts. A velvet glove of easy onboarding still works if new identities earn trust gradually through attested, useful tasks before gaining full voting weight.
